The '''Galactic Del Soli tournament''' was a sporting event. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] members entered the [[The Free Access Grill|Free Access Grill]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]], the patrons bombarded them with questions about [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] events, including wanting to know who won the tournament.
